key_highlights: ASX ended a volatile week higher, but housing auction sentiment deteriorated sharply, signalling a potential property correction
Aussie interest rate expectations rocketed, with housing inflation remaining a persistent RBA constraint, raising hawkish repricing risk
Pilbara mining activity booms and Gateway Resources (GWP.AX) adds a 7km gold trend in WA, supporting materials sector momentum
ASIC warns insurers are short-changing homeowners on cash settlements, pressuring ASX-listed insurers (WBC.AX, CGF.AX, IAG.AX)
Qantas (QAN.AX) faces workforce fallout from sackings; Virgin (VIR.AX) insulated by fuel hedging and new fleet
Consumer trends show accelerating EV uptake, weight-loss drug demand, and 'dupe' brand shift, reshaping retail and healthcare dynamics
Fed policy uncertainty and US midterm dynamics add external volatility to AUD and global risk appetite

sectors.trend: Pilbara iron ore activity surges; Gateway Resources adds major gold discovery in WA; small-cap miners (X2M, Discovery Alaska, Metal Hawk, Bapcor) lead ASX runners
sectors.implications: Supportive for BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX on iron ore volumes; gold names (GWP.AX, NGM.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows amid rate uncertainty

sectors.trend: Rising rate expectations pressure mortgage volumes; housing auction sentiment deteriorates; ASIC scrutiny of insurer cash settlements creates reputational and regulatory risk
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face NIM pressure if RBA holds; insurers (WBC.AX, CGF.AX, IAG.AX) face margin compression from settlement disputes

sectors.trend: Australia sets 'high bar' for fossil-fuel-powered data centres; oil majors retreat on clean energy commitments; Virgin insulated by fuel hedging
sectors.implications: Positive for gas/coal names (SOL.AX, WDS.AX) on data-centre demand; pressure on ESG-driven capital allocation for BHP.AX, WES.AX

sectors.trend: Accelerating EV uptake, weight-loss drug (GLP-1) demand surge, 'dupe' brand shift; major fruit grower lays off ~1,000 workers; childcare sector in crisis
sectors.implications: CSL.AX benefits from GLP-1 pipeline; WES.AX, WTW.AX face margin pressure from dupe-brand competition; agriculture names under stress

sectors.trend: Qantas workforce fallout from sackings; Virgin's new fleet and fuel hedging provide relative resilience; Suburban Rail Loop cost overruns deepen
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational and reputational risk; VIR.AX relatively insulated; infrastructure REITs and construction names face budget pressure

key_themes: RBA hawkish repricing risk amid sticky housing inflation
Housing market correction risk: deteriorating auction sentiment, rising rates, potential 'crash' narrative
Mining resilience: Pilbara iron ore boom and WA gold discoveries
Insurer regulatory overhang from ASIC cash-settlement scrutiny
Consumer bifurcation: premium GLP-1/healthcare vs. value 'dupe' brands and EV adoption
Political uncertainty: One Nation/Hanson momentum, immigration policy debate
Fed policy and US midterm dynamics as external volatility drivers

risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; reduce REIT and rate-sensitive bank exposure; monitor CPI and housing data
Reduce ASX 200 REIT weight; favour defensive dividend payers; monitor auction clearance rates and dwelling approvals
Underweight WBC.AX, CGF.AX, IAG.AX pending ASIC findings; favour reinsurance or diversified financials
Reduce QAN.AX exposure; consider VIR.AX as relative-value transport play
Maintain AUD hedging on offshore exposure; monitor US midterm outcomes and Fed commentary

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and iron ore miners on Pilbara boom and WA gold discovery
opportunities.rationale: Pilbara activity surging; Gateway 7km gold trend adds optionality; safe-haven demand amid rate uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Add CSL.AX on GLP-1 / weight-loss drug demand surge
opportunities.rationale: August data shows strong Australian appetite for weight-loss drugs; CSL's pipeline and distribution benefit structurally

opportunities.recommendation: Favour Virgin Australia over Qantas in transport
opportunities.rationale: Virgin insulated by fuel hedging and new fleet; Qantas faces workforce and reputational drag

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and rate-sensitive bank exposure ahead of potential RBA hawkish shift
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising rate expectations and housing inflation pressure NIMs and property valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight ASX insurers pending ASIC settlement findings
defensive_moves.rationale: Regulatory and reputational risk from cash-settlement shortfalls could compress margins and trigger policyholder attrition

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash / short-duration bond allocation as a buffer
defensive_moves.rationale: Volatile week, political uncertainty, and Fed ambiguity argue for liquidity

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to trade in a narrow, volatile range. Housing data and RBA commentary dominate. Insurer regulatory overhang caps financials. Mining provides relative strength. Expect 1–2% index swings on rate-expectation headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds from Pilbara iron ore, gold, and GLP-1 healthcare offset housing headwinds and political uncertainty. A gradual RBA easing cycle in H2 2026 would re-rate banks and REITs. Key swing factor is whether housing correction becomes self-reinforcing.
